question: Six girls decided to record a video of their talks, one on each separate day of the same week. Sunday will be a rest day. P said Friday will suit her. U will start the process and record on Monday. S will record immediately before T. Q will record on a day exactly between the days of U and S. T selected Thursday. Which day is left for R to record the video?
solution:
